newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe Steel, Global One to offer int'l call service.
newsitem.headline: Kobe Steel, Global One to offer int'l call service.

text.p: Kobe Steel Ltd said on Friday that it and the multinational telecoms venture Global One plan to jointly launch an international call service.
The companies plan to start the service after the Japanese government allows companies to offer public call services through leased lines from international carriers in October.

A spokesman for Kobe Steel said details of the venture had yet to be hammered out, but the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said in its Friday evening edition that plans are for rates to be about 50 percent lower than those offered by Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd, Japan's biggest international call operator.

Global One, set up in January 1996 as a joint venture of France Telecom, Deutsche Telekom AG and Sprint Corp, has already begun offering services such as frame-relay and customised network solution to Japanese customers.
